0022600111.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-2, 13th in the West) visit the Phoenix Suns (0-1, 15th in the West) in their third game of the season, and they have yet to win on the road this year. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 101-97 win in Phoenix on February 5, 2026. Golden State is without Stephen Curry (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Brandin Podziemski (back), while Charles Bassey is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions.
